scope: Player-visible Classic GIVE item-transfer admission, rejection, success presentation, and MegaMUD/Borin compatibility. Raw imported binaries remain local-only.

native_contract.pre_target_item_rejection: You may not give that item away!
native_contract.capacity_order: add_item_to_inventory evaluates carried encumbrance plus incoming item weight before committing; failure removes/rolls back the attempted add and returns false to _cmd_give, which emits the sender-side cannot-accept line.
native_contract.restriction_order: The item-level may-not-give branch occurs in the item GIVE path before the item-target recipient parse/admission branch. SET RECEIVE refusal occurs before remove/add commit.
native_contract.limited_item_policy: Limited status alone is not a blanket GIVE rejection; evidence-backed item ownership/no-give restrictions remain authoritative.

reforged_integration.recipient_filtering: Successful room-observer GIVE text is sent at High priority and excludes the source and direct recipient to avoid duplicate presentation.
reforged_integration.capacity: Recipient root inventory admission is capped at the native 100 carried-root slots and the recovered encumbrance capacity is checked before cross-character commit.
reforged_integration.failure_translation: Reforged metadata restriction terminology is not exposed on the Classic terminal stream; item GIVE restriction failures map to the native may-not-give line.
reforged_integration.mega_mud: MegaMUD remains on the ordinary MajorMUD terminal stream; its retained executable inventory independently recognizes the recovered capacity and GIVE-success tokens.
reforged_integration.borin: Borin must not depend on a private GIVE compatibility shim. Persistent inventory/client-data is authoritative for ownership; ordinary native GIVE terminal lines remain available for human/client presentation.
